name: gizza-ai/line-series-chart
summary: Render numeric series as an SVG line chart.

tool.description: Render one or more numeric series as an SVG line/time-series chart (axes, y min/mid/max labels, a colored line per series, and a legend for multiple series). Separate series by newlines or ';'; within a series separate values by commas/spaces. Optional title, width, height.

data.description: Numeric series to plot. Separate series by newlines or ';'; within a series separate values by commas/spaces (x is the value's index). E.g. '1,2,3,2,5' or '1,2,3\n3,2,1'.
